chunks: A theologian, known as Turk al-Harawi, asked him: How many daughters did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) have?

He said: Four. He asked: Which of them is most superior? He replied: Fatima. He asked: Why did she become the most superior, whereas she was the youngest in age and had the least companionship with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)?

He said: Because of two qualities, which Allah bestowed upon her exclusively, to prolong her status and honor and glorify her; one is that she inherited the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and no other child of his did, and the second is that Allah the Exalted preserved the progeny of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) through her and did not preserve it through anyone else.
And He did not single her out for that except due to the excellence of sincerity which He knew from her intention.
Al-Harawi said: I have not seen anyone who spoke and answered in this matter with a better or more concise reply than his answer.
ai.seo_question: Why is Fatima al-Zahra considered superior to her sisters in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this dialogue with the theologian Turak al-Harawi, Shaykh al-Tusi records Husayn ibn Ruh’s concise defense of Lady Fatima’s (peace be upon her) preeminence, emphasizing that her superiority stems not merely from age or companionship but from two unique divine privileges: being the sole inheritor of the Prophet’s spiritual and material legacy and the exclusive vessel for the continuation of his progeny. This narration underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on Fatima’s distinct ontological status as the link between the Prophethood and the Imamate, validated by her profound sincerity (ikhlas).

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 353 - A theologian famous as Turk Harawi [Budail bin Ahmad] asked Husain bin Rauh: How many daughters did the Messenger of Allah (s) have?

Husain bin Rauh said: Four. The inquirer asked: Which of them is most superior? He replied: Fatima (s). He asked: How is she the most superior, whereas she was the youngest and she lived for the least time with the Holy Prophet (s)?

Husain bin Rauh said: Because of two qualities, which Almighty Allah bestowed to her, because of His grace on her and in order to make her status clear to all: One is that Fatima is the sole inheritor of the Messenger of Allah (s) and no son of the Prophet shared this, (as all expired during lifetime of Prophet). Secondly Allah, the Mighty and the High placed the progeny of the Messenger of Allah (s) only in her being and the survival of the generations of the Prophet was through her and not through anyone else.
And Almighty Allah gave these two excellence to her exclusively due to her precedence in sincerity and because He knew about her pure intention and conscience.
Harawi says: I have not seen anyone giving a better or more brief and more useful reply to this question.
